text: Built-in SSH client with native tabs for remote connections
Can connect to serial ports for embedded/Arduino development
quote: Connect to serial ports for embedded/Arduino work

text: Multiplexes panes, tabs and windows across local and remote hosts with native mouse support and scrollback
quote: Multiplex terminal panes, tabs and windows on local and remote hosts, with native mouse and scrollback

text: Searchable scrollback with keyboard/mouse navigation and a search mode
quote: Searchable Scrollback (use mouse wheel and `Shift-PageUp` and `Shift PageDown` to navigate, Ctrl-Shift-F to activate search mode)

text: Quick Select mode highlights common text patterns for fast keyboard-driven copy
quote: Quick Select mode allows you to quickly highlight text that matches commonly copied patterns, select a match by typing a one-or-two character prefix and copy it to the clipboard.

text: Watches config file and automatically reloads settings on change, applying most options immediately
quote: wezterm will watch the config file that it loads; if/when it changes, the configuration will be automatically reloaded and the majority of options will take effect immediately.

text: CLI subcommand can interact with a running wezterm instance to spawn programs and manipulate tabs/panes
quote: The _cli_ subcommand interacts with a running wezterm GUI or multiplexer instance, and can be used to spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes.

text: Remote wezterm multiplexer sessions can be reached over an SSH domain, preserving tabs
quote: Take a look at the multiplexing section for an alternative configuration that connects to a remote wezterm instance and preserves your tabs.

text: Embedded SSH library provides an integrated client for ad-hoc SSH connections
quote: wezterm uses an embedded ssh library to provide an integrated SSH client. The client can be used to make ad-hoc SSH connections to remote hosts

text: New tabs inherit the current working directory via OSC 7 so you don't need to manually cd
quote: When the current working directory has been set via OSC 7, spawning a new tab will use the current working directory of the current tab, so that you don't have to manually change the directory

text: Supports ligatures, color emoji, font fallback, true color, and dynamic color schemes
quote: Ligatures, Color Emoji and font fallback, with true color and dynamic color schemes

text: Can output images directly to the terminal
quote: Output an image to the terminal

text: Supports iTerm2-compatible image protocol plus a built-in imgcat command
quote: iTerm2 compatible image protocol support, and built-in imgcat command

text: Lets users change font size and color scheme at runtime
quote: changing the font size and color scheme.

text: Configuration values can be overridden via command-line flags
quote: wezterm allows overriding configuration values via the command line

text: Shell integration exposes a function to set custom user variables
quote: The shell integration provides a shell function named __wezterm_set_user_var which can be used to set your own user vars.
